map.标准分 Z =（原始分 X − 均值 μ）÷ 标准差 σ；百分位 = 标准正态累: Standard score Z = (raw score X − mean μ) ÷ standard deviation σ; percentile = cumulative standard normal probability Φ(Z) × 100% (about 50% at Z=0, about 97.5% at Z=1.96 and about 10% at Z=−1.28). |Z| of at least 2 is uncommon (about 5%) and at least 3 is extreme (about 0.3%); T = 50 + 10Z makes scores easier to interpret.
map.公式：Z = (X - μ) / σ。Z 分数表示原始分数与平均值之间相差几个标: Formula: Z = (X - μ) / σ. The Z-score shows how many standard deviations a raw score sits above or below the mean.
map.百分位基于标准正态分布近似估算。: The percentile is estimated approximately from the standard normal distribution.
map.若数据不服从正态分布，Z 分数解释需谨慎。: If the data are not normally distributed, the Z-score should be interpreted with caution.
map.📚 深度解析：Z 分数（标准分数）衡量某数值相对数据集均值的标准差偏离，用于跨量: 📚 In-depth: the Z-score (standard score) measures how far a value deviates from the mean of a data set in standard deviation units, and is used for comparison across scales and for spotting outliers.

map.离群判断：据 |Z| 评估偏离程度。: Outlier check: judge the deviation by |Z|.
map.成绩对比：不同科目分数统一标准化比较。: Score comparison: standardize marks from different subjects onto one common scale.
map.示例：均值 80、标准差 10、得分 95，Z=(95−80)/10=1.5，高: Example: with mean 80 and standard deviation 10, a score of 95 gives Z=(95−80)/10=1.5, which is 1.5 standard deviations above the mean.
map.等于均值；正为高于、负为低于平均。: It equals the mean; positive means above the mean and negative below it.
